facts.fact: MainOne (subsidiary MDX-i) opened its Lekki Data Centre in Lagos, declared open and ready for service, offering colocation, cloud and disaster recovery; launch on Thursday before the 2015-01-16 dateline.
MainOne states its Lekki Data Centre is Tier III, designed to TIA-942 standards (operator statement; no Uptime certification named).

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
